it.txt: Era vice-prefeito e assumiu a prefeitura em 01/04/2026, depois que Giordanna Mano renunciou ao cargo para concorrer a deputada federal na eleição de 2026.
it.txt_en: He was vice mayor and took over as mayor on April 1, 2026, after Mayor Giordanna Mano resigned to run for federal deputy in the 2026 election.
